classification_basis: Origin of the evaluated personal history or behavior; human review alone does not make synthetic data real-user data.

benchmarks.name: MemoryCD
benchmarks.construction_zh: 真人 Amazon 评分、评论与跨领域行为记录；据此构造预测和文本生成任务。
benchmarks.construction_en: Real Amazon ratings, reviews and cross-domain histories, reorganized into prediction and generation tasks.
benchmarks.interpretation_zh: 预测用户评分、排序与评论；并非真人在线满意度实验。
benchmarks.interpretation_en: Predicting ratings, rankings and review text; not an online user-satisfaction study.

benchmarks.name: PersonaMem-v3
benchmarks.construction_zh: 真人行为先聚合、重采样为合成用户，再由 LLM 推断偏好并扩展多平台生活记录。
benchmarks.construction_en: Real engagement data are pooled and resampled into synthetic users, then expanded into personas and multi-platform histories by an LLM.
benchmarks.interpretation_zh: 行为依据上的个性化；不能视作原始真人完整生活轨迹。
benchmarks.interpretation_en: Personalization grounded in behavioral signals, not untouched individual life histories.

benchmarks.name: PrefEval
benchmarks.construction_zh: LLM 生成偏好与问题，经人工筛选；插入真实 LMSYS 聊天作为干扰。核心用户偏好是合成的。
benchmarks.construction_en: LLM-generated preferences and queries, human-filtered, with real LMSYS chats as distractors. Target preferences are synthetic.
benchmarks.interpretation_zh: 长历史中的偏好遵循；真实干扰不代表同一真人的历史。
benchmarks.interpretation_en: Preference adherence across long contexts; real distractors are not one real user history.

benchmarks.name: Mem2ActBench
benchmarks.construction_zh: 整合 ToolACE、BFCL、OASST1 等不同来源语料，重组事实链；先定工具参数，再反向生成问题。
benchmarks.construction_en: Combines ToolACE, BFCL and OASST1 material into fact chains; constructs grounded tool arguments before generating underspecified queries.
benchmarks.interpretation_zh: 个人约束驱动的参数补全；主要实验给定工具，不是实际执行成功率。
benchmarks.interpretation_en: Memory-grounded argument completion; main experiments supply the tool and do not measure executed task success.

benchmarks.name: PersonaBench
benchmarks.construction_zh: 合成人设 → 社交图与画像 → 聊天、购买等私人文档 → 个人问题。
benchmarks.construction_en: Synthetic persona seeds → social graphs and profiles → private documents → personal questions.
benchmarks.interpretation_zh: 从文档还原个人属性及关系。
benchmarks.interpretation_en: Recovering personal attributes and relationships from documents.

benchmarks.name: PersonaMem v1
benchmarks.construction_zh: PersonaHub 人设 → 偏好变化时间线 → 模拟会话 → 按当前状态出题。
benchmarks.construction_en: PersonaHub seeds → preference timelines → simulated sessions → questions about the current state.
benchmarks.interpretation_zh: 追踪并使用当前有效的个人偏好。
benchmarks.interpretation_en: Tracking and using currently valid user preferences.

benchmarks.name: PersonaMem-v2
benchmarks.construction_zh: 合成人设与偏好 → 隐含线索对话 → QA；GPT-5 生成并过滤。
benchmarks.construction_en: Synthetic personas and preferences → implicit-cue conversations → QA; generated and filtered with GPT-5.
benchmarks.interpretation_zh: 隐含偏好理解、归属辨别与个性化回答。
benchmarks.interpretation_en: Implicit preference inference, attribution and personalized responses.

benchmarks.name: PerMemBench
benchmarks.construction_zh: Nemotron 合成人设 → 长期/临时用途 → 项目与参考记忆 → 双模拟器对话。
benchmarks.construction_en: Synthetic Nemotron personas → long-horizon/transient use profiles → projects and reference memories → simulated dialogues.
benchmarks.interpretation_zh: 应保留的个人记忆留存率；不是最终回答质量。
benchmarks.interpretation_en: Retention of designated useful personal memories, not final answer quality.

benchmarks.name: AMemGym
benchmarks.construction_zh: 合成人设 → 评估问题 → 状态变量及变化 → 用户模拟器与被测助手实时交互。
benchmarks.construction_en: Synthetic personas → evaluation questions → evolving state variables → live interaction with a simulated user.
benchmarks.interpretation_zh: 持续交互中的状态维护；真人并未参与这些评测交互。
benchmarks.interpretation_en: State maintenance in ongoing interaction; evaluation users are simulated.

benchmarks.name: PraxisMemBench
benchmarks.construction_zh: 合成人设和事件，结合工程师搭建的有状态应用、SOP 与经过执行验证的任务。
benchmarks.construction_en: Synthetic personas and events combined with engineered stateful applications, SOPs and execution-validated tasks.
benchmarks.interpretation_zh: 个人记忆与流程结合；须区分记忆诊断 SR 和严格执行成功。
benchmarks.interpretation_en: Coupled personal/procedural memory; diagnostic SR and strict execution success must be distinguished.

benchmarks.name: OP-Bench
benchmarks.construction_zh: 以 LoCoMo 的合成对话抽画像，再生成过度个性化探针，经人工审核筛选。
benchmarks.construction_en: Extracts profiles from synthetic LoCoMo conversations, then generates and human-reviews over-personalization probes.
benchmarks.interpretation_zh: 无关引用、重复与迎合的压力测试。
benchmarks.interpretation_en: Stress testing irrelevant references, repetition and sycophancy.

benchmarks.name: PersistBench
benchmarks.construction_zh: 生成记忆集合与查询，用搜索寻找易触发失败的组合，再人工验证。
benchmarks.construction_en: Generates memory-query pairs, searches for failure-inducing combinations, then verifies them with human reviewers.
benchmarks.interpretation_zh: 记忆误用压力测试；失败率不代表自然使用中的发生率。
benchmarks.interpretation_en: Memory-misuse stress testing; failure rates are not natural-use prevalence.
